comment: Homeworks are insane. They're due every two weeks. He makes the homeworks due the same time that part of the project is due. Daily quizzes are so annoying. Don't take him if you don't have to. He's so confusing and the tests are extremely hard.

Tests are definitely too long, as another student mentioned. The book is dry & unclear - he can explain things pretty well, but he quizzes you on the assigned reading at the beginning of class, so if you didn't understand the text, too bad. Homeworks are long & due every 2 weeks.

My mom told me if I don't have anything nice to say I shouldnt say it. But I will say this: He refers to himself as JOSH (an acronym for his name) and kicked me out of office hours because he was "sick of it" for the day. avoid at all costs.
Teaching quality and clarity were sub par. Tests were too long to the point that people were leaving whole pages blank. Avoid if at all possible.

Josh definitely pushed our class, but his grading system made up for the difficult exams. Homework was only five problem sets throughout semester and small, ongoing research project. Difficult class, but I would recommend it, and it probably went by faster than any other 75 min classes I've taken!
